objective: sum over candidate tables of unhappiness[table] * x[table], unhappiness = rank[last guest] - rank[first guest]

rank.description: Position on the guest list; tables spanning a wide rank range are unhappy

max_table_size.description: Maximum guests per table; candidate tables are all guest subsets of size 1..max_table_size

decision_variables.x[table]: binary, 1 if the candidate table is used

constraints.seat[guest]: sum over tables containing the guest of x[t] = 1
